new_mics.note: New mic: the 5 PM St. Marks mic on Monday, which was missing. Straight from St. Marks Comedy Club: Monday through Friday 5 PM, Monday through Wednesday also 6 PM, $10 signing up on sendyouravails.com, free drink with the signup. END TIME 6:00 PM, NOT the usual 90 minutes: this venue starts another mic at 6 PM on this day, and one room cannot run two mics at once, so the 5 PM has to finish by then. That is the schedule saying it is a one hour mic without using the words. Everything else inherits the venue's existing rows.
